rows.en:
But… that satellite never came back to Earth!

The experiment failed…

We believe the satellite he was aboard drifted through space until it washed up on some planet.

But that planet had no water or air like Earth's!

Then…

you're saying that while he was surviving in that planet's bizarre climate, he… changed into this form?
Yes… This is all the information on Jamila that Paris HQ sent us!

Most likely… Jamila spent decades making his way back to Earth…

with nothing but resentment and hatred toward us humans in his heart…
I quit! I'm not fighting Jamila!
What are you talking about!?
Come on… Jamila's one of our predecessors, isn't he? How can I fight someone like that!?
Yeah, but…

Listen, Arashi!

We could… we could end up with the same fate as Jamila any day now, you know!
Ide…

Ide… I understand how you feel!

But… Jamila has become an enemy of mankind now!
Damn it… You idiooot!!
Hayata, do you read me?
Yes, Cap…
Uwaaaagh…
Hey, Go… How'd it go? Find anything?

Well… other than getting attacked by Gigants, no progress at all…

Kishida! About that ghost light I saw near the radar base…

Go… listen. That's nothing as creepy as a ghost light!

That's the light of happiness. Get it, Go? A sacred flame burning in two people's hearts!

Go, keep this between us… I might be getting married soon.
Really!? Who's the lucky…

Shhh!! That's a secret!

Well… I'll introduce you one of these days.

I'm looking forward to it. Congratulations, first of all!

By the way, changing the subject…

Has the woman we took to the hospital that time recovered yet? I'd like to ask her about that night!
Uh, well… She's still… on strict bed rest!
Huh…!? She can't even talk?
Right, right, right! Can't even talk!!
I see. That's too bad…
Cap! Kelbaan has appeared!
What!? The Battle Fleet Nation Naager…? That's trouble…
Jamila! Is there no human heart left in you anymore!?
Huh…!? Kishida went to the hospital?
He looked really happy, and he was all dressed up.
Hmm… That's strange. She's supposed to be on strict bed rest…
What's she like?
Well, she's really beautiful.
Oh!? You think so too, Go?
Huh…? No, not really…

My, what a lovely scent…

Mr. Kishida… Not only did you save my life, you've been so kind to me…

You don't need to worry about that.

Akane… I want you to get well as soon as possible!

Lately… nothing but good things have been happening to me. Soon the radar I developed will be finished, too…
Radar?
That's right… MAT's long-range radar, the most powerful in the world, is about to be completed.
Mr. Kishida, you made a radar…?
Ah… Aaaah…
Akane, Akane!! I'll go get a doctor right now!
Don't!
I'm all right now.
Go home! Mr. Kishida, please go home!
A kaiju has appeared near the radar base!!
What!? Is the radar all right?
No problems so far! But depending on what the kaiju does next…
Roger!!

Akane, I'm sorry…

I don't want to part with you like this! But… I have to go! Next time, I promise…
We can't see each other anymore! Please don't come!

Wait…!

Keep this, and think of it as me…
Akane…

Kishida… there really was a kaiju at that spot!

I was relieved when I heard the Science Patrol had taken care of it, but…

maybe it's a different kaiju.

What's wrong?

Ah… You're worried about the radar, aren't you?

After all, you've been tied up developing it for the past few years. No way you'll let some kaiju smash it to bits! …Right?
Listen up! Don't let them lay so much as a finger on the radar base!
All right, all units, sortie!!
Kyaaaaan! Kyaaaaan!!
That's the voice! That's what I heard that night…
So it was that thing's voice…
Kishida… did something happen? You're not acting like yourself.

Go, I need a favor!

I want you to give this back to her at the hospital.
Why?

She says she won't… see me anymore.

And I… I just can't understand why.
But still… don't you think you should keep it?

No… Every time I look at it, I think of her…

I can't stand how much it hurts. Go, please! Take it back to her…

Kishida…

I still think… you're the one who should keep it!

Go, I need a favor!

She gave me this charm, but… I want you to give it back to her at the hospital.
Here, drink this…
Thank you…

…!?

Ide? This is unusual. Are you off duty today?
I… I… Ah, it's no good! No good! Phew…
What's wrong?
Well… he just showed up out of nowhere, and he's been like this the whole time.

Cap…

Ah… no, Mr. Tachibana! What should I do?
What should you do? What's the matter?

Well, you see…

my skills have been recognized, and I've been invited to join the TDF's science group.
Isn't that amazing!? Why are you so torn about it?

Well, sure, when it comes to research and development, I'm second to none. But…

I like to think I take pride in my duties with the Science Patrol, too…

Only, after the Jamila business, I can't say that anymore…

I keep wondering whether going to the TDF now would mean running away from the Science Patrol… I don't know what I want anymore.

Hmm… Helping out the TDF doesn't mean you're quitting the Science Patrol!

Why not go help them with your Science Patrol badge still on, and your head held high? Right, [HERO2]?

uncertain: U13224/U13227: Jamila referred to as 'he' (the satellite's pilot, a former human, 'one of our predecessors').
U13256: Injured Woman (later named Akane Hirota) speaking; 'Mr. Kishida' used for 岸田さん to keep her polite register.
U13261, U13264, U13270: narration rows continue the previous speaker's line (split rows).
U13288: alternate version of U13282 mentioning the charm (お守り); translated separately.
